description:
Read the remaining call time on this account and get the minutes of conversation left on the prepaid credit (subscription minutes included, with their expiry date) and the account limits (simultaneous calls, calls per day). Compliance: read-only; no payment can be made from here (only the account owner adds credit, in the web app).

    Use it before a long call (e.g. one with a long hold) or after place_phone_call failed for insufficient credit. Read-only. Credit cannot be added from here: if it is low, tell the user to add credit from their account in the web app.
name: get_account_balance
title: Get remaining call time
